column4: Dialect-arm subtests of one test: this job sets ONLY CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so the postgres and mssql arms skip by design and the mysql arm runs. Declared by name so the broad per-dialect lines in multi-db-ci-initial-measurement.tsv keep their measured counts (a specific line claims its own skips first, cleat#2729). Measured 2026-11-20 with only the MySQL DSN set: exactly these two arms skip.

Same shape for the SQL Server job: it sets ONLY CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the postgres and mysql arms skip by design and the mssql arm runs. Measured 2026-11-20 with only the SQL Server DSN set: exactly these two arms skip.
